title: The IaC rename, last step: the DNS role stops trusting the old name
why: SovereignWebsite__Factory is SovereignWebsite__IaC since about 01:05 UTC on 23 Nov 2026. DNS apply ran under the new name at 01:12 UTC (run 45093227626, by factory.c: GitHub sent the IaC subject, the role was assumed, all four zones updated), so the Factory subject is no longer needed. Step 5 of factory.c's rename plan.
summary: Removes: repo:SovereignWebsite@358722364/SovereignWebsite__Factory@1464324035:environment:apply. Keeps the IaC subject. Never touches the audience, the principal or the role's permissions.
